description: This PHP class 'DetailedLeave' represents a detailed data transfer object (DTO) for leave requests in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It encapsulates leave information, including associated leaves, status, period, balance, allowed actions, and workflows, and provides methods to access and manipulate this data.
external_methods: Some methods from strategy objects used in getLeavePeriod()

classes.name: DetailedLeave
classes.description: A DTO class representing detailed information about a leave request, including status, period, balance, and permissible actions within the HR system.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Returns the main Leave entity associated with this detailed leave.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Sets the main Leave entity and resets cached properties.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Assigns multiple Leave entities (leaves) to this detail object.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of leaves associated with this detail object.

methods.name: getDatesDetail
methods.description: Generates and returns detailed date information for the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the leave with additional details.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave balance related to the leave period.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Determines the leave period based on the leave date and related leaves.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Provides a list of actions (e.g., approve, reject) allowed for this leave request.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves applicable workflows based on leave status, employee, and leave type.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a specific action is permissible for this leave request.

methods.name: getWorkflowForAction
methods.description: Fetches the workflow associated with a specific action.
